title: THE UNHEARD: A Game That Sends You Outside, Teaches a Machine to Listen, and Makes It Prove Every Word
why_read: A creative gamified concept pairing audio AI models with a 'go outside and record sounds' mechanic, interesting as a design idea though light on hard technical novelty.
analysis: THE UNHEARD is a game concept where players record real-world sounds and teach a frozen CLAP audio embedding model to recognize them via a separate retrieval memory, explicitly avoiding any model fine-tuning. The architecture, a local React PWA with a FastAPI backend, SQLite storage, and Gemma via Ollama for dialogue, is a reasonable local-first AI app stack. The core technical idea, pairing frozen embeddings with an updatable external memory rather than retraining, is a legitimate and relevant pattern in retrieval-augmented AI systems, even though the project itself is a hackathon submission rather than rigorous research.
